name: Clam Bait
summary: At Shadowprey Village, Mai'Lahii trusts one bait above all others. He asks for ten pieces of soft-shelled clam meat from the wrecked ship north along the coast.

sections.title: The Best Bait
sections.body: Mai'Lahii asks you for bait fish cannot resist. He has fished all his life and trusts soft-shelled clam meat above all else. North of Shadowprey Village, a wrecked ship lies off the coast, and soft-shelled clams are scattered throughout the area. He wants ten pieces of the meat.

sections.title: What Mai'Lahii Says
sections.body: Mai'Lahii says the witch doctor told him to go fishing for his headache and that he would feel better. He feels better already.

faq.answer: Mai'Lahii is a fisherman in Shadowprey Village on the Desolace coast. She has fished all her life.

faq.q: Where can the soft-shelled clams be found?
faq.answer: Soft-shelled clams are scattered around a wrecked ship north of Shadowprey Village, off the coast.

faq.q: Why does Mai'Lahii want clam meat?
faq.answer: Mai'Lahii says soft-shelled clam meat is the best bait, and fish cannot resist it.

faq.q: How much clam meat does Mai'Lahii want?
faq.answer: Mai'Lahii wants ten pieces of soft-shelled clam meat.
